## Summary

- add generic StandardLit image-based lighting with diffuse irradiance, GGX prefiltered specular mip chains, and a split-sum BRDF LUT
- keep visible sky rendering separate and preserve existing ToonLit ambient behavior
- add content-keyed runtime environment-map preparation and fixed-camera GPU regression coverage
- document the renderer contract in ADR 0121

## Compatibility

No serialized scene/material schema, Stable ID, importer-specific render path, or public shading-model contract is changed. Existing non-IBL scenes retain the historical ambient path.

## Validation

Windows Validation is started by the trusted dispatcher. Cargo.lock changes require full workspace validation.
